product.name: Drive-Thru Timer & Monitor
product.description: A camera-based system that measures and records the time each vehicle spends in the drive-thru from entry to order completion.

product.name: Dining Room Timer
product.description: A timer system that tracks the service speed of guests inside the dining room from entry to receiving their order.

product.name: Security Upgrade
product.description: An upgrade to existing security systems providing HD, high frame rate video with loss prevention features accessible remotely.
